proposal_locations.detail: One request per lane and four globally.
Four contenders x eight rounds against one shared ETag, up to32simultaneous attempts; no required fresh-tag/round barrier/content-change rule.

evidence.reproduction: Run M02.10_DESIGN_CORRECTNESS_CAS_REPLAY.py. Pure content-stable-token CAS models produce8success/24conflict with fresh per-round tags and changed bodies;1/31 when one initial tag is reused;32/0 for unchanged-body writes that preserve the tag. Each can be scheduled with peak4; the separately permitted32-overlap schedule also exceeds the declared4-global limit by8x. These are abstract counterexamples, not observed RustFS behavior.

findings.requested_fix: Freeze eight sequential, barriered rounds of four contenders, one freshly read shared tag per round and at most four global requests. Use distinct round/generation/contender-bearing replacement bodies and verify the winner identity plus changed tag with an independently counted GET before the next round. Pin expected8winners/24conditional conflicts absent unexpected errors; retain raw412/409/other statuses. Keep the known-conflict GET+one-retry as a separate bounded case. Treat unchanged tags or unresolved results explicitly, not as an inferred successful round. Retain the wrong schedule/body/ETag variants as red controls.
findings.scope: Pre-freeze experiment design/accounting/admission, not an implemented-code or measured-provider finding.

implementation_requirements: Freeze exact event timestamps/500ms window semantics, first-dirty batching deadlines/natural final drain, and candidate-specific tick/heartbeat/election/snapshot configuration before measurements. raft-rs RawNode::tick is application-driven; the audited example100ms is an example, not an automatic shared default.

Give16KiB batch/32KiB queue caps explicit encoded-versus-logical byte scopes. Keep offered-event terminal dispositions separate from attempt statuses and temporary client-unknown states; a resolved unknown is not a second offered event. Count GET/retry/response/orphan/root/page operations and directed serialized edges independently.

Preserve strict capped repetitions on both architectures, full ordinary suites/source-bound coverage and original gates. Use separate new M02.10 supporting helpers rather than modifying accepted M02.09 reports/helpers.
